Underline RETLDC 0.1.0 source companion
======================================
Local asset: dist/Underline_RETLDC_0_1_0_Corresponding_Sources.zip
Contains an exact tracked application-source snapshot and original Qt/PySide
6.11.1 archives plus Mesa 11.2.2 source and license/reassembly evidence.
SOURCE_MANIFEST.json records original member hashes and version provenance.

This source snapshot accompanies the existing FFT_Apache code baseline; its
SOURCE_MANIFEST.json identifies the precise committed snapshot and candidate
EXE hash. Pending, uncommitted FFT changes are excluded. If final application
code changes, regenerate the companion and checksums before distribution.

Proposed public delivery (not yet uploaded): the same GitHub v0.1.0 Release as
the final accepted binary asset, with SHA256SUMS.txt. The final binary filename
is not settled; historical portable assets are preserved.
Planned source asset URL:
https://github.com/aleistercrowleybeast666/Underline_RETLDC/releases/download/v0.1.0/Underline_RETLDC_0_1_0_Corresponding_Sources.zip

This is direct source-asset preparation, not a three-year written offer.
Do not claim the URL is live before authorized publication and download checking.
Modified-library Python recombination instructions: docs/Qt_Library_Replacement_0_1_0.md
Native C++ libraries were not rebuilt. Manual Windows IME acceptance was not run.
